correctness.rationale: The complete 5142-face covering complex is enumerated with all 15 graph-edge simplex vertices. The toggle matching is checked acyclic by topologically sorting all oriented Hasse edges, with 2561 pairs and critical vector (five 3-cells, fifteen 4-cells). Exact signed boundaries of all six natural 3-cycles vanish; their Morse image matrix has rank five and one alternating relation. Fifteen explicit 4-cycles have unimodular Morse projection determinant -1 and force the only possible 4-to-3 Morse differential to vanish. Thus H3 is five dimensional and the exterior-power quotient identifies its equivariant action. Independently all eleven S6 conjugacy-class traces satisfy the claimed character through invariant-face Lefschetz enumeration. The standalone verify.py code was run and ended VERIFY_OK. Thirty exact chain-level equivariance checks cover five adjacent transpositions and six generators.
